# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `entinel-technologies` MCP server pointing at Entergram's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.entergram.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth 2.0 with Entergram user login.
- Logo references `https://www.entergram.com/logo.png`; the file could not be downloaded when the plugin was added.
